ideas.title: +1 Wind Grip 🌪️
ideas.hook: A tornado sits at the end of a long road and the wind pushes you back. Every step forward gives +1 grip, until you can walk straight into the eye of the storm.
core_loop: Walk into the wind (+1 grip per step)
Grab flying debris for bonus grip
Reach the next weather zone (rain, hail, tornado, hurricane)
Spend grip on boots and anchors that cut the push-back
Rebirth to face a bigger storm
ideas.twist: Gusts come in waves. Crouch at the right moment or get blown back past your last checkpoint, so timing matters as much as stats.
retention: Leaderboard for farthest into the eye
ideas.why_now: Disaster / weather sits at 1.74 momentum with 10 new games ([🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It! 31,304 CCU, [🌊] Steal Eggs From Tsunami! 11,832), and no tracked +1 game uses weather yet. +1 stat per action is still at 2.01 with 38 new games (+1 Spider Arm🕷️ 30,244 at 18 days) even after slipping 0.25 this week, and the +1 + Escape pair already has 10 young games.
ideas.differentiator: Other +1 runners grow a body part on a flat track; here the stat fights a visible force pushing back, with timed gusts as a skill check.

ideas.title: Repaint the Town 🎨
ideas.hook: Every few minutes a storm wrecks the town. You and your crew repaint and patch the houses, and owners pay by how close you get to the original look.
core_loop: Wait out the disaster (flood, hail, tornado) in your van
Pick a damaged house and see its 'before' photo
Paint, patch and replace parts to match it
Get paid by match score
Upgrade brushes, sprayers and your crew yard
ideas.twist: Some owners hate the old look: match their 'wish' sketch instead for double pay, but miss and they pay nothing.
retention: Bigger towns unlock with crew level
ideas.why_now: Paint / create x Disaster / weather is one of the top gaps in the data (score 4.79). Paint / create is at 1.95 momentum with 18 new games ([🎃] Ragdoll Sandbox 20,794, Backseat Rally 15,044), and cleanup sims like [🎃] Clean the Moon! (9,663 CCU at 25 days) show players like fixing a mess.
ideas.differentiator: Disaster games are about surviving the storm; this one starts after it, scoring how well you restore what it broke.

ideas.title: Storm Chaser Farm 🚜
ideas.hook: Your farm is on the back of a truck. Drive it into storms on purpose: lightning, hail and twisters mutate your crops into rare, high-value harvests.
core_loop: Plant seeds in your truck-bed plots
Check the radar and drive toward a storm
Hold position in the storm to mutate crops
Escape before the truck takes too much damage
Sell at the market and upgrade truck, plots and armour
ideas.twist: The closer to the storm's core, the rarer the mutation, but your truck can flip and spill half the harvest.
retention: Collect every mutation in an index
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm jumped 0.52 this week to 1.53 with 37 new games ([UPD] Durian Garden 🍈 14,339 at 16 days, [2x WEEKEND] Farm Evolution 10,249). Vehicle Sim is at 1.67 with 29 new games ([NEW LIMITED & UPDATE] Onthel Purwodadi 21,920), and Disaster / weather holds 1.74.
inspired_by: [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It!
ideas.differentiator: Weather in farm games just happens to you; here you drive the farm into it and risk the crop for the mutation.

ideas.title: Guess the Vault 🏦
ideas.hook: A vault door opens for three seconds. Everyone guesses how much cash is inside, and the closest guess without going over takes the pot.
core_loop: Peek into the vault for 3 seconds
Type your guess
Reveal: closest without going over wins
Spend winnings on bigger vault tables
Climb from piggy banks to a billionaire's vault
ideas.twist: One vault per round is a trap filled with fake bills: call 'fake' instead of guessing to steal the pot.
ideas.why_now: Quiz / guess x Money / rich is the top quiz gap (score 4.65). Quiz / guess is steady at 1.32 with 9 new games (Thai Quiz Duels [UPDATES] 8,288 at 20 days, [🎃] Don't Say The Obvious! 2,294). Money / rich is still 1.64 but cooled 0.40 this week, so this keeps the build small.
ideas.differentiator: Quiz duels ask trivia; this is a pure eyeball-estimate game with a bluff round, so anyone can win.

ideas.title: Giant's Game Night 🎲
ideas.hook: You are a tiny game piece on a giant's table. Roll the dice to race across the board while the giant's hands, snacks and spilled drinks wreck the spaces.
core_loop: Roll the dice to move
Land on spaces that trigger minigames or traps
Dodge the giant's hand and falling cards
Reach the finish first to win coins
Unlock new boards (kitchen table, kid's bedroom, casino)
ideas.twist: Last place gets to control the giant's hand for one turn and flick a leader off the board.
ideas.why_now: Dice / cards x Giant / huge is a gap in the data (score 3.14). Dice / cards rose 0.21 this week to 1.09 with 11 new games ([⚡] Steal a Superpower! 8,148, [🎉UPD 2] Roll A Stickman! 6,571), and Giant / huge holds 1.63 with 14 new games (Bug Evolution [🦟] 27,572 at 28 days).
ideas.differentiator: Dice games on Roblox are roll-for-rarity; this is a real board race with a giant-sized physical world as the hazard.

ideas.title: Build a Prison 🔒
ideas.hook: Wardens build and run a prison for cash. Other players spawn as inmates and try to break out of it. Each escape costs the warden money.
core_loop: Warden: place cells, walls, cameras and guards
Earn cash per inmate held per minute
Inmate: find weak spots, dig, sneak and run
Escaped inmates earn rewards and fame
Both sides upgrade between rounds
ideas.twist: Inmates can rate a prison after escaping. Low-rated prisons get flagged on the map and attract more inmates.
ideas.why_now: Prison / police jumped 0.47 this week to 1.46 with 15 new games (Tesla Roadster Chase 13,247 at 16 days, Punch Out Of Prison 9,695). Escape / run rose 0.36 to 1.61 with 35 new games, and Tycoon / base building has 81 new games (🧸 My Small Business 15,468).
ideas.differentiator: Prison games give you a fixed map to escape; here players build the prison, so every escape route is different and someone's money rides on it.

ideas.title: Guilty or Not? ⚖️
ideas.hook: Each round a suspect stands in court with three clues. Vote guilty or not guilty before the timer ends, then watch the reveal and the verdict.
core_loop: Read the case and inspect the clues
Vote guilty or not guilty
See the reveal and earn coins for correct calls
Unlock harder cases and bigger courtrooms
Spend coins on judge and lawyer outfits
ideas.twist: One player each round is the secret culprit and can plant a fake clue; catch them for a bonus.
ideas.why_now: Quiz / guess x Prison / police is a gap in the data (score 3.0). Prison / police is up 0.47 week on week to 1.46, and quiz games like Thai Quiz Duels [UPDATES] (8,288 CCU at 20 days) and Find The Country 🌍 show the face-off format still pulls players.
ideas.differentiator: Not a trivia quiz: each round is a short mystery, with a player-culprit that adds a social deduction layer.

ideas.title: Human or Robot? 🤖
ideas.hook: A room full of identical robot workers. Some are players pretending to be robots. Watch how they move and guess who is human.
core_loop: Join as a hidden human or as a detective
Humans copy the robot routines to blend in
Detectives scan and guess
Correct guesses earn coins, wrong ones cost them
Unlock new factories and robot skins
ideas.twist: Robots get a random 'glitch' every round, so even real robots sometimes act human.
ideas.why_now: Quiz / guess x Robots / mechs is a gap (score 3.0). Robots / mechs holds 1.78 momentum with 12 new games ([🎃] Clean the Moon! 9,663, [🔰] Steel Fighters 9,017) though it dipped 0.24 this week, so a small build fits.
ideas.differentiator: Robot games are about fighting or cleaning; this one is about acting like a robot and spotting who isn't.

ideas.title: Harvest Before Dark 🧟
ideas.hook: By day you farm. At night zombies come for your crops, and some crops fight back: pumpkin bombs, pea walls, garlic fog.
core_loop: Plant and water crops by day
Harvest some to sell, leave some planted to defend
Survive the night wave
Sell harvest and zombie drops
Expand the farm and unlock stronger crops
ideas.twist: Crops that survive a night grow into a rare 'night' version worth five times more, so you have to risk your best plants.
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is up 0.52 this week to 1.53 with 37 new games ([UPD] Durian Garden 🍈 14,339). Zombies rose 0.2 to 1.52 with 9 new games (Ragdoll Reality 🩸 24,415, [UPDATE 1.0] 30 Floors Up 6,366 at 12 days).
ideas.differentiator: Farm games are peaceful; this adds a nightly threat where your crops are both income and defence.

ideas.title: Gravity Cards 🪐
ideas.hook: Every card is a planet, moon or star with a gravity number. Play cards to pull your opponent's moons into your orbit and steal them.
core_loop: Open card packs
Build a 10-card deck
Duel: play planets to pull enemy moons
Win packs and moons
Fill your galaxy index
ideas.twist: Black hole cards are rare and pull everything, but you lose them after one use.
ideas.why_now: Dice / cards rose 0.21 this week to 1.09 with 11 new games ([⚡] Steal a Superpower! 8,148 at 27 days). Space holds 1.59 with 14 new games ([💉INJECTIONS] Ragdoll Playground 15,183, Sweep The Moon 🌕 3,816 at 14 days).
ideas.differentiator: Planet games are collect-and-steal sims; this is a simple head-to-head card duel built on one easy stat.
